pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygons with low-to-moderate edge sharpness. Individual dark regions exhibit smooth pixel-intensity transitions at the borders, with spatial area decreasing from the neck toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways. Topological junction nodes are visible where three or more corridors converge. Pixel thickness of the corridors is variable, narrowing in the mid-flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the upper neck and back, representing the short mane hair against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark avian silhouette is present in the image space immediately superior to the dorsal ridge profile.
